dissents.reason: UNH costs 21.1x trailing earnings that fell 26.1% against the prior four quarters, a richer multiple than JPM or PGR on the sharpest earnings decline on the sheet, so it fails both halves of my test and looks like a value trap rather than a bargain to hold at a 20% weight.
PGR fails my trend filter because its 40-week average is not rising, and it is not a pullback either, sitting 0.1 widths above its channel line with the weekly MACD histogram still falling.
META's 26-week channel falls 12% a year, so it fails my first test, and a rising MACD histogram with the MACD line still below zero is a bounce inside a downtrend, not a pullback in a rising channel.
